_comment: Copy this file to local.settings.json (which is gitignored) before running `func start`.
Everything a deployed Function App gets from infra/modules/control-plane.bicep, a local host
gets from here. Both timers run on their real schedules locally: the reset only acts on
SystemConfiguration[ResetDayOfMonth], and the usage sync no-ops with a warning while
Gateway__LogAnalyticsWorkspaceId is empty (there is no local Log Analytics to query).
Never put a real secret in local.settings.json — cloud secrets are Key Vault references.
The quota tier table is NOT here: appsettings.local.json carries it (#201), and setting it in
both places would give one table two sources. A deployed host gets it from infra instead.
